distribution.summary: Anhui; Beijing; Chongqing; Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Guizhou; Hebei; Heilongjiang; Hong Kong; Hunan; Jiangxi; Shaanxi; Shandong; Sichuan; Xizang; Yunnan; Zhejiang; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) document a broad mainland distribution and Taiwan. Smith et al. (2020) substantially expands the reviewed geographic evidence. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan and broad China occurrence; its CE/NE/NO/SW regional wording is not converted into additional provinces. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Current host summary retains the historical host records. Beaver & Liu (2010) states only that the species is polyphagous, so no additional host taxon is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiodmus rubricollis (Eichhoff, 1876).
